# Smartspanner CMMS

> Cloud-based CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) software for maintenance management, asset tracking, and facilities management.

Last updated: 2026-09-01

## About

Smartspanner is built from operational maintenance experience and designed to reduce friction in everyday work. Teams can start with focused work-order, asset, and preventive-maintenance workflows, then introduce multi-site controls, inventory governance, reporting, APIs, and other advanced capabilities as requirements grow.

Based in Gateshead, United Kingdom.

- Website: https://www.smartspanner.com
- App: https://app.smartspanner.com
- Support: https://support.smartspanner.com
- Contact: sales@smartspanner.com
- Phone: +44 (0) 191 300 1217

## Key Features

- Work order management (reactive and planned)
- Preventive maintenance scheduling and automation
- Asset management with hierarchy and location structure
- Multi-site deployment with site-based permissions, multiple currencies, multiple languages, site-specific KPIs, and global site rankings
- Multi-site inventory and stock control with categories, BIN locations, replenishment rules, intelligent perpetual counting, site-level Stock Control, and organisation-wide Inventory Performance
- Connected mobile apps (iOS and Android); an internet connection is required and the apps do not work offline
- Multi-language app interface (English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Lithuanian, Thai, Malay, Japanese)
- In-app translation for supported user-entered maintenance content including procedures, checklists, instructions, descriptions, and comments
- Reporting and dashboards
- Subcontractor management
- Checklists and inspections
- Equipment checks for pre-use inspections and walkarounds, with asset QR scanning, photo evidence, alerts, follow-up work orders, and asset-level history (Advanced plan)
- Permits to work (UK-aligned permit-to-work workflows, mobile signature capture, PDF export for wet signatures, email sharing, and linked CMMS users)
- Fire risk assessments structured around current UK guidance, with configurable reviews, photo evidence, and work-order actions; Smartspanner supports the customer's process but does not guarantee compliance
- IoT condition monitoring for supported vibration, temperature, energy, and flow data, turning configured signals and thresholds into maintenance attention
- Failure codes and root cause tracking
- Purchasing and purchase orders
- API access with broad coverage for key integration requirements, including reporting and links to wider operational systems
- Lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures

## Pricing

All prices are per user, per month and exclude applicable taxes. A 14-day free trial is included and no credit card is required.

- Basic: £15/user/month — Core CMMS features, work orders, preventive maintenance, asset management, mobile apps
- Standard: £21/user/month — Adds procedures, subcontractors, failure codes, asset labels, spare part labels, technician leave
- Advanced: £27/user/month — Adds checklists, equipment checks, condition monitoring, statistics, purchasing, permits to work, API access

All plans include unlimited work orders, unlimited support, daily backups, and automatic updates.

## Industries Served

- Manufacturing
- Injection moulding
- Facilities management

- Logistics and warehousing
- Industrial maintenance

## Best Fit

Smartspanner is suited to organisations ranging from small maintenance teams to global, multi-site companies. It keeps common workflows short while making deeper operational controls available when required. Common use cases include replacing maintenance spreadsheets, managing planned preventive maintenance, tracking reactive work orders, keeping asset history, coordinating contractors, controlling multi-site inventory, supporting higher-risk work with permits to work, and giving technicians connected mobile access in the field.

## Countries and Markets

Smartspanner is based and supported in the United Kingdom and serves maintenance teams internationally, with dedicated information pages for the United States, Australia, and New Zealand.

## Language Support

The Smartspanner app interface supports English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Lithuanian, Thai, Malay, and Japanese. Smartspanner also supports in-app translation for supported user-entered maintenance content, including procedures, checklists, instructions, descriptions, and comments, while keeping the original text accessible when needed. Sales, onboarding, and support are currently provided in English from the UK team. Smartspanner does not currently operate local sales offices in Germany, France, Spain, Portugal, Brazil, Lithuania, Thailand, Malaysia, or Japan.

## Differentiators

- Focused implementation — a first site and core workflow can be configured in a focused setup session; wider rollout time depends on data, integrations, sites, and workflows
- Short everyday workflows — designed around the job technicians and supervisors need to complete
- Depth without obstruction — advanced multi-site, safety, inventory, purchasing, reporting, and integration controls remain available without cluttering common work
- Transparent pricing — starting from £15/user/month, excluding applicable taxes
- Included support — telephone and online support are included
- Connected mobile access — native iOS and Android apps for field use where an internet connection is available
- Condition monitoring — optional sensor monitoring, including supported vibration sensors, can turn equipment data into maintenance action
